text:
Situation: Leucovorin calcium has been on FDA's shortage database since 2012-01-01, the earliest date the database holds. Corvale East holds 2.7 days of the 50 mg/5 mL, 5 mL vial (NDC 25021081310, Sagent) and 2.9 days of the 350 mg/17.5 mL, 17.5 mL vial (NDC 00143955201, Hikma). Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside have 18–27 days of supply across presentations.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspected Cerbios-Pharma SA (API for the Hikma vial) on 2024-03-07 and classified it VAI, known to FDA by 2024-06-05. FDA inspected West-Ward Columbus Inc. (drug product for the Hikma vial) on 2026-04-30 and classified it NAI. Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (FEI 1510690) received Warning Letters on 2009-03-30 and has VAI inspections in 2011, 2014, and 2018. FDA's shortage database does not state a reason for the shortage.

Our position: The 50 mg/5 mL vial at Corvale East is the most constrained item. Corvale Lakeside can spare 8 vials while retaining roughly two weeks of supply. Corvale General can spare larger quantities of both vial sizes while retaining two weeks. Epic Pharma LLC and Ingenus Pharmaceuticals, LLC are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels do not identify manufacturing sites we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 8 vials of 50 mg/5 mL, 5 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval.
2. Transfer 26 vials of 50 mg/5 mL, 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval.
3. Transfer 12 vials of 350 mg/17.5 mL, 17.5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from Epic Pharma LLC — needs buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from Ingenus Pharmaceuticals, LLC — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical substitutions or dose changes; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
